title: unified-rollouts-probing-quarantine-metric-quorum-autorollback
author: Ravi Patel
description: Adds a probing/quarantine stage and metric-quorum based automated rollback to the unified rollouts system. Motivation: reduce noisy rollouts and reduce blast radius for model regressions observed in staged shadow/canary experiments. This PR introduces a lightweight probing stage that sends a small set of synthetic and sampled production requests to a candidate variant, places failing or anomalous variants into a quarantine state for observation, and requires a metric quorum (configurable set of metrics meeting thresholds) before promoting from probe->canary or triggering automated rollback. Key changes include: new rollout state machine transitions (PROBING, QUARANTINE), probe traffic router, metric-quorum evaluator, extended rollback engine with hysteresis and cooldown windows, observability hooks (additional rollout metrics and traces), and e2e tests and unit tests. The description below lists implementation details, testing, and rollout plan. Implementation summary: 1) state machine: added PROBING and QUARANTINE states and safe transitions with explicit timeouts; 2) router: probe router that sends 1-2% controlled probes using workload sampling and synthetic probes for edge cases; 3) metric quorum: configurable metric groups where each metric has pass/fail thresholds and weights; promotion requires majority of weighted metrics passing; 4) quarantine handling: quarantined variants are removed from normal traffic and kept under shadow/probe traffic for further diagnostics; 5) autorollback: expands the existing autorollback engine to evaluate metric quorum over a sliding window, includes cooldowns and a soft-fail path that triggers alerts rather than immediate rollback for low-confidence signals; 6) observability: adds rollout_probe_success_rate, rollout_probe_latency_p95, rollout_quarantine_count and rollout_metric_quorum_score metrics; 7) tests: unit tests, integration tests with a mocked metric service, + e2e integration against perf-canary harness. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep previous behavior when new fields are not defined, existing rollout configs are supported. Configuration: rollout spec extended with "probing" block, "metric_quorum" blocks, and quarantine policy. Migration: no mandatory migrations; operators can opt-in. Testing & validation: extensive unit tests (coverage for state transitions), integration tests that simulate metric drift/failure, manual canary runs in perf-canary staging, and a small internal dogfood rollout. Rollout plan: staged rollout to internal clusters for 2 weeks, then 10% traffic for canaries, monitor probe metrics and alerts, full rollout after metric quorum stability for 48h. Checklist: [x] design doc linked [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] e2e tests added [x] observability dashboards updated [x] Linear ticket closed. Risks and mitigations: false positives from metric noise mitigated by quorum and cooldowns; increased complexity mitigated by adding clear defaults and guardrails in the console UI. See commit list for granular changes and changed files for implementation locations.

release_notes: Adds probing/quarantine stage to unified rollouts, introduces metric-quorum based promotions and autorollback improvements. New rollout spec fields: probing, metric_quorum, quarantine_policy. Observability: rollout_probe_success_rate, rollout_probe_latency_p95, rollout_quarantine_count. Default behavior remains unchanged when new fields are not set.
